change.summary: The Commission must complete a simplification review by 30 April 2026 and a general review by 30 June 2030, then every five years. These reviews evaluate the Regulation's impact on deforestation, trade, and small operators, and may lead to legislative proposals.

obligations.text: Carry out a simplification review by 30 April 2026.
obligations.quote: By 30 April 2026, the Commission shall carry out a simplification review of this Regulation and on this basis present a report to the European Parliament and to the Council accompanied, where appropriate, by a legislative proposal.

obligations.text: Carry out a general review by 30 June 2030 and every five years thereafter.
obligations.quote: By 30 June 2030 and at least every five years thereafter, the Commission shall carry out a general review of this Regulation and shall present a report to the European Parliament and the Council accompanied, if appropriate, by a legislative proposal.

reasons: The obligations are addressed to the European Commission, requiring it to carry out simplification and general reviews of the Regulation.
Your shop is a seller of furniture, wooden goods and leather goods, not the Commission, so no obligation binds you.
